review:
A 5x4 western that's stayed popular for one reason: sticky multiplier wilds. In the base game, wilds carry 2x, 3x or 5x, adding together when several are in a win.

Three scatters give eight free spins, and two to five more during the round add four to 20. In the bonus every multiplier wild sticks, building up across the reels for the rest of the feature. A simple bonus that can snowball. 96.51% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
